$comment: The PM's target organisation model vs what the code does today. Rendered as annotations in the map, never as shipped behaviour.

asBuilt.summary: One gated transition. Pending Approval → Final Approved requires `quotations.approve`, held by quotation_manager, sales_manager and admin. Operations does not approve.

steps.does: Prepares and prices the quotation; submits to Pending Approval
Reviews as lead — no separate status; lead is an assignment, not a gate
Final Approved — the only enforced gate

target.summary: Three approval layers; the Operations manager gives the final approval.

steps.does: Prepares and prices; first-level check of catalog + rates
Commercial review — tier choice, transport charge, terms
Final approval — units available for the hire window, transport feasible

gaps.asBuilt: Schema only (work_order, technical_service, fault types); no screens; `plant` notification department reserved.
gaps.target: Inspection + servicing module with Plant supervisor and Technician roles.
Supplier + PO module; cost feeds the rate roster with Sales.

gaps.asBuilt: Inventory screens live but owned by the `operations` role; receive / issue / transfer / stock take are schema only.
gaps.target: Storekeeper role; whiteboard; receiving from Procurement.

gaps.asBuilt: One `operations` login does coordination, transport and inventory.
gaps.target: Transport coordinator + Ops manager split out.

gaps.asBuilt: One `finance` role; junior / senior ladder is UI-only in the prototype.
gaps.target: AR junior approves, AR senior publishes (distinct permissions).

gaps.asBuilt: machine_return.condition_status carries compensation_required; Finance Returns page is a prototype.
gaps.target: Plant inspection result feeds the assessment; Ops manager signs off; Finance raises the credit note / charge.
